name: M5.Signature.binary_dvd_antisymm
statement: ∀ P Q : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ Q → Q ∣ P → P = Q
context:
theorem M5.Signature.binary_monic : ∀ P : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ≠ 0 → P.Monic := by
  change ∀ P : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ≠ 0 → P.Monic
  intro P hP
  have h : ∀ c : ZMod 2, c ≠ 0 → c = 1 := by decide
  change P.leadingCoeff = 1
  exact h P.leadingCoeff (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP)
guidance: If either polynomial is zero, divisibility gives both zero. Otherwise binary_monic gives monicity of both; use Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated and associated_of_dvd_dvd. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
